title: Aparichita
desc: A writer visits his friend's village after he learns about his disappearance. On visiting the place, he discovers that the latter was murdered.

title: Brahmastra: Part One - Shiva
desc: With Isha by his side, DJ Shiva rises to a crescendo of love and fortitude to embrace his role as the chosen protector of the universe's most powerful weapon.

title: Raghavendra Stores
desc: Hayavadana and his wife go to a resort on a holiday. However, when they encounter politicians over there, chaos ensues, as they strive to save their friend, who gets in trouble with the ministers.

title: Bahaddur
desc: A man falls in love with a charming woman, but problems surface when her father arranges for her to tie the knot with another man.

title: Kranthiveera Sangolli Rayanna
desc: Sangolli Rayanna, the army chief of the Kingdom of Kittur and a freedom fighter, revolts against the British in a bid to oust them from the country.
